objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the command injection weakness of a Java Struts customer service form on Tomcat 9 and read the flag in /tmp/flag.
hints: Find the input the server hands to a system command, and how shell metacharacters are treated.

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class lets your input reach a system shell?

steps.title: Identify the framework
steps.prompt: Which Java web framework handles the form? (name only)

steps.title: Name the expression language
steps.prompt: In which expression language is input evaluated? (acronym)
